label: ZXHN F8648P XGS-PON ONT
description: ZTE ZXHN F8648P AX6000 XGS-PON residential gateway: one 10GE LAN port, four GE LAN ports, two POTS ports and concurrent dual-band WiFi 6 (4x4 2.4 GHz plus 4x4 5 GHz at 160 MHz). Single SC/APC XGS-PON port, routable with NAT/firewall.
notes: Vendor figures for the ZXHN F8648P: **one XGS-PON WAN (SC/APC), one 10GE LAN, four GE LAN**, two FXS voice ports, concurrent 2.4 GHz 1148 Mbps and 5 GHz 4804 Mbps radios (the AX6000 split). **The voice ports are not modelled** - they are POTS lines, not data interfaces. This entry absorbed a second file for the same box (`f8648p.json`, identical hardware, 5 GHz recorded as 4800 Mbps and the 10G port left without a connector): one product, one file.
